name: goldener-research
description: Local skills and plugins for the goldener-research repo.

plugins.name: sync-idea-issues
plugins.description: Import GitHub issues labeled idea into Goldener research IDEAS.md files. Use for syncing idea issues; preserve source questions and context, deduplicate, and deliver locally or through the authorized PR/issue workflow.

plugins.name: sync-researcher-issues
plugins.description: Research named people or GitHub researcher issues, add their relevant papers and researcher entries to Goldener research, and discover qualifying co-authors. Use for researcher imports and publication research.

plugins.name: sync-paper-issues
plugins.description: Add papers named by title/link or GitHub paper issues to Goldener research bibliographies, confirm relevance from abstracts, and discover qualifying co-authors. Use for paper imports and bibliography updates.

plugins.name: sync-lab-issues
plugins.description: Screen a named lab or GitHub lab issues for papers relevant to Goldener research, track qualifying researchers, and deliver bibliography updates. Use for lab or research-group publication imports.

plugins.name: sync-conference-issues
plugins.description: Screen a named conference edition or GitHub conference issues across published tracks and workshops for Goldener-relevant papers and researchers. Use for conference bibliography imports; resolve an omitted year to the latest published program.

plugins.name: sync-theme-issues
plugins.description: Build Goldener research bibliographies for named ML themes or GitHub theme issues, selecting citation-ranked relevant seeds per theme (20 by default, overridable) and discovering qualifying researchers. Use for thematic literature searches.

plugins.name: paper-review
plugins.description: Read a named or randomly selected Goldener bibliography paper in full and save an evidence-backed local HTML review with its main figure, innovations and limitations. Use for full paper reviews; never publish the result.

plugins.name: short-paper-review
plugins.description: Condense an evidence-backed paper review into a short local draft for plain text, social posts or newsletters. Use for short paper summaries and posts; create a full review first when needed and never publish or send the draft.

plugins.name: propose-goldener-features
plugins.description: Propose ranked Goldener features grounded in repository ideas and papers and current Goldener code/issues. Use for roadmap requests; present proposals individually and create each issue only after explicit approval.

plugins.name: contact-researchers
plugins.description: Draft personalized outreach to Goldener research researchers selected by name, theme or pull request. Verify published addresses and prior contact, then save Gmail/IMAP/local drafts. Never send messages.
